question: F, G, H, I, M, N, and O are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. Only two people sit between F and G, when counted from the right of F. Only two people sit between G and M, when counted from the right of G. Only three people sit between F and N, when counted from the right of F. H sits to the immediate left of I. Who sits third to the left of O?
solution:
**Given: **F, G, H, I, M, N, and O are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table.

1. Only two people sit between F and G, when counted from the right of F.

2. Only two people sit between G and M, when counted from the right of G.

3. Only three people sit between F and N, when counted from the right of F.

4. H sits to the immediate left of I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a806e67f7c6966367ceba5b29eb9da2df875fcaf8fd8b2049e8fa74a1214832.png] 

O, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5120be684e7c49576b68a4bdf4d62b1b83826f4c2d6aad7a086c3779f6d297b.png] 

Thus, I sits third to the left of O.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
